mapper.select:
SELECT r.reservation_code AS reservationCode, r.class_code AS classCode, r.member_code AS memberCode, c.name AS className, c.operator_code AS operatorCode, cr.activity_name AS activityName, img.image AS classImg, c.address AS address, TO_CHAR(r.reservation_date, 'YYYY.MM.DD(DY) HH24:MI') AS reservationDate, TO_CHAR(s.class_date, 'YYYY.MM.DD(DY)', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=KOREAN') || ' ' || s.start_time AS classDate,
/* 💡 DB의 예약 상태(r.status)를 가공 없이 그대로 조회 */ r.status AS classStatus,
NVL(rev.review_code, 0) AS reviewCode
FROM reservation r JOIN class c ON r.class_code = c.class_code LEFT JOIN schedule s ON r.schedule_code = s.schedule_code LEFT JOIN creator cr ON c.operator_code = cr.operator_code LEFT JOIN class_img img ON c.class_code = img.class_code AND img.type = '대표' AND img.sort_order = 1 LEFT JOIN review rev ON r.reservation_code = rev.reservation_code
WHERE r.member_code = TO_NUMBER(#{memberCode})
AND NOT (r.status LIKE '%취소%' OR r.status LIKE '%환불%') AND TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(s.class_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || s.start_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') >= SYSDATE
AND NOT (r.status LIKE '%취소%' OR r.status LIKE '%환불%') AND (r.status IN ('수강완료', '이용 완료') OR TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(s.class_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || s.start_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') < SYSDATE)
AND (r.status LIKE '%취소%' OR r.status LIKE '%환불%')
AND r.status = #{status}
ORDER BY r.reservation_code DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE reservation SET status = '취소' WHERE reservation_code = TO_NUMBER(#{reservationCode}) AND member_code = TO_NUMBER(#{memberCode}) AND status NOT LIKE '%취소%' AND status NOT LIKE '%환불%'
UPDATE payment SET status = '환불완료', refund = amount, refund_date = SYSDATE WHERE reservation_code = TO_NUMBER(#{reservationCode})

UPDATE reservation SET status = '수강완료' WHERE reservation_code IN ( SELECT r.reservation_code FROM reservation r JOIN schedule s ON r.schedule_code = s.schedule_code WHERE TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(s.class_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || s.start_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') < SYSDATE AND r.status NOT LIKE '%취소%' AND r.status NOT LIKE '%환불%' AND r.status != '수강완료' )
